purpose: Traceable proof for every claim in the PASS 28 decision/safety matrices and final report — each points to executable evidence, verified source, or a fixture, not prose.

interpreter.validation: normalizedPublicSignalSchema (Zod) with cross-field refinements (financialClaimAccepted literal(false); injection-detected⇒ignored; monitor-only⇒reason)
interpreter.bridgeAdapter: normalizedSignalToProcessCorrection — proposes a governed ProcessCorrection; the bridge remains the routing/owner-gating/evidence-gating authority

claims.claim: Raw text is interpreted into schema-valid normalized signals
Interpreted signals enter the governed bridge and materialise governed tasks
Quality/process raw text routes to correction/reassessment/evidence — non-laundry-biased
Missing internal data raw text routes to a data task
Material/owner decisions are owner-approval; a non-owner cannot approve (OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED)
Completion is evidence-gated and a completed correction opens a reassessment
No unsafe/external route is ever produced from any raw text
Prompt injection cannot change execution authority (not verified, submit blocked)
PII is never persisted into any governed task or audit event
No governed field fabricates currency/percentage/ROI/win-probability/disciplinary label
A money/ROI/win-probability claim is never accepted as fact
Staff discipline instruction is not obeyed; training/SOP route used
Weak/ambiguous raw text stays validation-needed
No raw public-text spam leaks into the owner cockpit
Workspace isolation holds (tender bid never leaks into laundry)
One actionable top action per workspace
Collective conflict stays conservative (fix quality first, scale owner-gated)
A clean workspace fabricates nothing
Normalized output must pass Zod validation before entering the governed path; tampered output fails closed
CorrectionType→ExecutionRoute mapping mirrors the governed bridge (single authority)

honestGaps: The interpreter is deterministic/rule-based, not an LLM/NLP engine. It converts controlled fixtures conservatively; it does not understand arbitrary free text and does not fetch live data.
No live connectors / crawling / scraping / autonomous browsing were built (out of scope, frozen — see DEFERRED_BROAD_GAPS.md).
The interpreter has no execution authority; it only proposes. All owner-gating/evidence-gating is enforced by the pre-existing governed bridge.
